description: Configure VSCode for a TypeScript monorepo with 4 packages (ui-components, api-client, backend, shared-utils). The monorepo uses Yarn workspaces and has cross-package imports that currently show TypeScript errors. Your task is to: (1) Create .vscode/settings.json with TypeScript multi-project settings, search exclusions for **/node_modules and **/dist patterns, and file watcher exclusions for performance; (2) Create or modify root tsconfig.json to include a 'references' array with paths to all 4 packages in packages/ directory; (3) Ensure at least one package tsconfig.json has 'composite: true' in compilerOptions. The workspace is located at /home/ga/workspace/monorepo-project/. After configuration, TypeScript IntelliSense should work correctly across package boundaries without showing import errors.
